{{Quote|I knew I was going to regret this!|Mara Jade upon meeting the rancor|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
A pet '''rancor''', owned by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Takara]], lived in his [[Takara's stronghold|stronghold]]. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was captured by Takara's lieutenant [[Abron Mar]] and sent to a holding cell in Takara's stronghold. Jade escaped, and eventually encountered the [[Rancor/Legends|rancor's]] lair. Retrieving her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] from a nearby crate, Jade fought the rancor and [[Death/Legends|killed]] it. She later escaped the stronghold.

==Biography==
===Takara's new pet===
The [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Takara]] came into contact with a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]which he decided to keep as a pet. The rancor lived in [[Takara's stronghold]], where it had its own dungeon lair. It was locked off from the rest of the stronghold by a gate that a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guarded, and the rock-walled room contained a pool of sewage that was connected to a large, damaged sewage pipe.<ref name="MOTS" /> Usually, those who met the rancor were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by it.<ref name="MOTS" />

===Jedi and rancors===
[[File:Takara_Rancor_MOTS.png|thumb|right|200px|The rancor in its lair]]
During 10 ABY,<ref name="TNEC" /> [[Abron Mar]], Takara's right-hand man,<ref name="Features">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref> kidnapped [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]] while she worked to [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|retrieve]] a [[Global Communications Transponder|surveillance device]] for [[Ka'Pa]] [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]] to improve relations with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Leaving the [[Katraasii Spaceport]], [[Takara's organization|Takara's men]] locked Jade in the dungeon. When she awoke, Jade stole a key, unlocked her cell, and after evading guards, she crawled into the damaged sewage pipe and swam in the only possible direction: the rancor's lair.<ref name="MOTS" />

With a loud roar, the rancor lumbered out of a cove and prepared to attack the intruder to its lair. However, Takara's men had placed Jade's confiscated [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] on the other side of the lair's gate entrance, guarded by the Gamorrean. Using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], Jade [[Telekinesis/Legends|grabbed]] her lightsaber and dueled the rancor. Despite the rancor's efforts in trying to grab Jade with its massive clawed hands, it was unsuccessful in capturing its prey and fell victim to the Jedi's attacks. The Gamorrean rushed in to stop Jade, but she slipped through the opened gate and made her escape. Later, she retrieved the stolen device and was rescued from Takara's stronghold by Ka'Pa's men.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Takara's rancor was a large creature with [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. As a 5 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall [[Diet/Legends|carnivore]],<ref name="CE" /> the rancor ate any who stumbled into its lair. Upon sighting Mara Jade, the rancor roared at her before engaging.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|But the real gem of the level was a battle with a rancor! Luke had to rely on nothing but his brains and a kriffing rock to kill Jabba's rancor, so Mara had an advantage with her saber. But still, it was an exciting duel, and I ended up getting munched plenty of times.|Ryan Kaufman recounts his experience with the rancor|<ref name="Zombies!">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
Developed for the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' where it featured in the game, the original box art, and the game's manual,<ref name="MOTS" /> Takara's pet rancor first appeared in a [[LucasArts]] webpage about the game's story.<ref name="Story">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_story.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Story}}</ref> Takara's stronghold and the rancor encounter were all designed by [[Donald Sielke|Don Sielke]], and [[LucasArts]] continuity supervisor [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] would later recount the rancor encounter as one of his favorite moments in the level.<ref name="Zombies!" />
